tests.requirement: User can log in with valid credentials
tests.title: Valid login test
tests.preconditions: No preconditions
tests.steps: Log in with valid username and password.
tests.expected_result: Login is successful.

tests.title: Invalid login test
tests.preconditions: No preconditions
tests.steps: Log in with invalid username and password.
tests.expected_result: Login is rejected.

tests.title: Course browsing test
tests.preconditions: No preconditions
tests.steps: Browse the course list without searching.
tests.expected_result: The course list is displayed.

tests.title: Course search test
tests.preconditions: No preconditions
tests.steps: Search for a specific course using the search bar.
tests.expected_result: The searched course is displayed in the results.

tests.requirement: Search returns no results for invalid query
tests.title: Invalid search test
tests.preconditions: No preconditions
tests.steps: Search for a non-existent course using the search bar.
tests.expected_result: No courses are displayed in the results.

tests.title: Course enrollment test
tests.preconditions: The user is not enrolled in the course.
tests.steps: Enroll in a specific course using the enrollment form.
tests.expected_result: The user is successfully enrolled in the course.

tests.title: Double enrollment test
tests.preconditions: The user is already enrolled in the course.
tests.steps: Attempt to enroll in the same course again using the enrollment form.
tests.expected_result: Enrollment is rejected due to duplicate enrollment.

tests.title: Course access test
tests.preconditions: The user is enrolled in the course.
tests.steps: Open the specific course using the course list or search results.
tests.expected_result: The course content is displayed to the user.

tests.title: Course material test
tests.preconditions: The user is enrolled in the course.
tests.steps: View the course materials, such as assignments or quizzes.
tests.expected_result: The course materials are displayed to the user.

tests.title: Resource download test
tests.preconditions: The user is enrolled in the course and has access to the resource.
tests.steps: Download a specific course resource using the download link.
tests.expected_result: The resource is successfully downloaded.

tests.title: Assignment list test
tests.preconditions: The user is enrolled in the course and has access to assignments.
tests.steps: View the assignment list for the specific course.
tests.expected_result: The assignment list is displayed to the user.

tests.title: Non-enrollment access test
tests.preconditions: The user is not enrolled in the course.
tests.steps: Attempt to view or download a specific course resource without being enrolled.
tests.expected_result: Access is restricted due to lack of enrollment.

tests.title: Session timeout test
tests.preconditions: The user has an active session.
tests.steps: Wait for the session to timeout and then attempt to log in again.
tests.expected_result: The system logs the user out due to session timeout.

tests.title: Password reset test
tests.preconditions: The user has forgotten their password.
tests.steps: Initiate the password reset process and follow the prompts to reset the password.
tests.expected_result: The password is successfully reset.

tests.title: Logout test
tests.preconditions: The user has an active session.
tests.steps: Log out of the system using the logout link or button.
tests.expected_result: The system logs the user out and ends their session.
